strategy_explanation:
1. Start by buying a fixed amount of the asset when you first enter the market.  
2. If the asset price drops 7% from your last purchase price, buy double the amount you currently hold.  
3. Repeat step 2 each time the price falls another 7% from your most recent purchase price.  
4. Keep track of your total position and average entry price.  
5. When the combined value of all your holdings reaches a 2% profit overall, sell everything.  
6. Wait for the asset to fall again from its most recent peak before re-entering with your initial investment amount.  
7. Repeat the process.  

This strategy assumes you always have enough funds to double your position after each 7% drop.
